name: Erotic Psycho Story Inmu Danpen
original_name: エロティックサイコストーリー淫夢断篇
source:
Main character accumulates a lot of stress at work due to his boss Reiko reverse sexual harassment. So when an innocent girl runs away from home and seeks protection at his house, he lets all his anxiety loose.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在工作中饱受上司丽子的反向性骚扰，积累了沉重的压力。于是，当一名离家出走的纯真少女来到他家寻求庇护时，他把满腹焦虑全都发泄在了她身上。
